scene: A neon spark fires up the roof terrace transit docks above.
picture: Side-scrolling wide view of the hospital's rooftop dock. On the far left, a yellow funicular waits on sloped rails. The player stands left of centre, wearing his orange corduroy jacket, beanie, and brass telescope. In the centre sits a brass-legged bridge crawler, while on the right a suspended window-cleaner gondola rests beside the railing.
